Description: Uldin served in 374 AD as a fearsome Hunnic tumen commander (Tarkhan) and nomadic warlord, riding under the banner of the Ultzinzur. Sweeping westward across the Don alongside Khagan Balamber, he stood as the terrifying vanguard of the Great Migration. Reared entirely in the saddle across the Eurasian steppes, he possessed lethal accuracy with the asymmetric composite recurve bow at full gallop, combining horse archery with lassoes and curved iron sabers. Leading thousands of fluid cavalry skirmishers coordinated with subjugated Alan lancers, he perfected predatory feigned retreats and sudden encirclements, annihilating Gothic outposts along the Dnieper. Contemptuous of stone walls and agrarian treaties, this fierce nomad warrior lived to expand the grazing horizons of his horde. Across the boundless expanses of the Eurasian steppes, he perfected nomadic cavalry mobility and predatory wolfpack encirclement into lethal martial art. Reared entirely in the saddle, he executed rapid-fire horse archery with the composite recurve bow at full gallop, executing lightning nighttime assaults under blizzard cover. Mockingly contemptuous of stone ramparts and fragile treaties, he believed the earth belonged to those possessing the courage to conquer it on horseback. Leading from the vanguard, this untamed nomad warlord unleashed torrents of bodkin arrows, harvesting plunder and victory across collapsing frontiers.
